sloka: सुप्ता इव पुनर् उत्थाय आर्य पुत्र इति वादिनी ।रुरोद सा पतिम् दृष्ट्वा सम्वीतम् मृत्यु दामभिः ॥४-१९-२७॥
transliteration: suptā iva punar utthāya ārya putra iti vādinī ।ruroda sā patim dṛṣṭvā samvītam mṛtyu dāmabhiḥ ॥4-19-27॥

translations.english: Tara got up again, as if she woke up from sleep and addressing her husband garlanded with death, lamented.
